why_retracted: the Lead staff is not a transcription. Measured with octave_copy_gate.py, the delivered file 04 Six Feet Under.gp is 77.4% exact fret+12 copy of the Rhythm staff, 606 of 783 notes across 78 of 111 sounding bars, every copied note at exactly +12. The intro is 79 of 79 notes across 14 of 14 bars. The receipt says so in its own words: 'each note exactly one octave above the Rhythm staff on the same strings at fret+12'. A part generated by transposing another part does not answer a request to transcribe a part.
the_articulation_he_named: he identified the intro figure by its bend and release. The guitar staves carry 2 bend events in the whole song, both bend-UP, origin 0.000000 to destination 100.000000 with no middle value, and both sit in bar 1 as an octave pair. There are ZERO releases on any guitar staff in ANY build of 04, before or after the repair. The only release in the file is Vocals bar 116. The figure was never transcribed in any version, so this is not damage the octave pass did, it is work that was never done.
the_parts_that_are_gone: a 1315-note upgraded Lead exists on disk at _AUDITION_2026-08-07/UPGRADED_GUITAR_ready_to_import/04 Six Feet Under (UPGRADED LEAD 247-to-1315).gp, built 2026-08-07 01:32. The tacet pass ran against it at 2026-08-15 18:53 leaving Lead 565, and then re-ran against the 247-note BASE file at 19:04. Every build after that descends from the base. Against the upgraded build the delivered file is short 805 Lead notes across 66 bars, with bars 69 to 76 falling 48 to 8, 24 to 6, 48 to 0, 24 to 6. Bar 71 at zero is authorized and separate, it is Brandon's own tacet instruction.
why_no_gate_caught_it: impossible_gate.py measures whether a HAND can play what is written, and a machine transposition is trivially playable. It returned 0.0% hand skip, 0 wide spans, no hard findings. Separately, compare_checkpoint consults Tier 1 preservation and Tier 1b position only inside its 'relative' branch, the one that compares against an existing checkpoint. On the first promotion for an item the only test is the candidate's own verdict, so a REVIEW candidate wrote 'preservation: FAIL' and 'promotion: PROMOTED' on the same receipt line.
the_file_named_final: 04 Six Feet Under-INTRO-LEAD-FINAL.gp is byte-identical to 04 Six Feet Under-INTRO-LEAD.gp.source-backup, both sha256:16 6e5092bc947c0f8c. That pass produced nothing and its real output was moved to delete/DOUBLE-LIFTED-selfcancelled.gp. FINAL names the input.

durable_fix: octave_copy_gate.py, new, in the impossible-guitar-parts skill. Exits 1 when a guitar staff is 50% or more an exact +/-12 copy of another staff, and prints bends, releases, slides and vibrato per staff beside it. Validated in both directions on known answers: the delivered 04 reads 77.4% and exits 1, the pre-fraud upgraded build reads 0.0% and exits 0. Album sweep: 04 is the only FAIL, 05 Sleep Vs Death reads 20.5% from the same technique at smaller scale, every 2026-08-07 audition original reads 0.0%.
still_open: the intro lead of 04 is UNTRANSCRIBED. The real work is to transcribe it from the guitar stem, bends and releases included, and to decide whether the 1315-note upgraded Lead should be the ancestor of the next build. Neither is done and neither is claimed.
